text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Premises:
Plungers ::: Plungers suck.
Vacuums ::: Vacuums suck.
Vampires ::: Vampires suck.
Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
Duster(duster) ∧ HouseholdAppliance(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
∀x (HouseholdAppliance(x) → Suck(x)) ::: If something is a household appliance, it sucks.
